Cancellation policy
а full refund is possible if the cancellation is made more than 48 hours before the start of the trip
if the cancellation is made more than 24 hours before the start of the trip, the amount of the fine is 50%
if the cancellation is made less than 24 hours before the start of the trip, the amount of the fine is 100%
refunds will be made at the exchange rate set by Bank Indonesia on the date of payment
full refund is made in case of impossibility on the part of the provider to provide the service in full
the time period for consideration of the refund is up to 5 calendar days from the date of application
money refund period - up to 14 calendar days from the date of the decision to refund
tour cancellation due to weather conditions is accepted based on official information about the weather conditions that prevent safe conduct of events. Tour organizers have experience and knowledge of weather conditions along the route of the trip. No trip, for safety reasons, will be allowed if there is a travel ban
a subjective assessment of weather conditions by trip participants cannot be the basis for a decision to undertake or cancel a trip
